recentItems.title: Eagles Hall of Fame WR Harold Carmichael | NFL Players: Second Acts Podcast
recentItems.description:
On the latest NFL Players: Second Acts podcast, Peanut Tillman and Roman Harper sit down with Hall of Famer Harold Carmichael for a conversation full of history, personality, and stories from one of the NFL’s most unique careers. Carmichael reflects on his journey from an HBCU to the NFL, how he helped revolutionize the screen pass as a 6'8" receiver, and why it took so long to make the Hall. There are laughs, nicknames, and even a hands comparison between Peanut and Harold as they revisit the legacy of a receiver who defined consistency and longevity. A warm, insightful look at an NFL icon whose second act has been just as meaningful as his playing days.
